chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"The time for the night prayer (salat al-layl) is from midnight until its end."

key_terms.آخِرِهِ: its end, meaning the end of the night
key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night; here, the period in which the night prayer is performed
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the designated time or period for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the time for salat al-layl according to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal time window for salat al-layl. Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام teaches that it begins at midnight and continues until the end of the night.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1376 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"The time for the night prayer (salat al-layl) is from midnight until its end."
